note: Four-level citation audit. L1-L3 graded on the real PubMed record (title+abstract) for every system, so the reference source is identical across systems. L4 is corpus membership, reported separately rather than conflated with existence. Denominator is every PMID emitted; nothing filtered.

levels.L1: PMID resolves to a real PubMed record
levels.L3: resolved record mentions the entity the question asks about
levels.L4: PMID is in the retrieved corpus, so the evidence is openable
